# FinCo-Pilot

> A financial workspace for managing accounts, transactions, budgets and reports.

Private financial data and all account actions require authentication and the
existing workspace permissions. This document grants no access or authorization.
No public agent API is advertised by this catalog.

## Public pages
- [Sign in](https://fincopilot.app/login): Access an existing account.
- [Pricing](https://fincopilot.app/pricing): View available plans.
- [Support](https://fincopilot.app/support): View the configured support options.
- [Terms](https://fincopilot.app/terms): Terms page; content depends on operator configuration.
- [Privacy](https://fincopilot.app/privacy): Privacy page; content depends on operator configuration.
